questionText: Which of the following statements regarding Core Concept in Vocabulary, Idioms and Phrases is INCORRECT / NOT true?

options.text: It conforms strictly to the standard equilibrium conditions defined in NCERT Vocabulary, Idioms and Phrases.

options.text: It operates in direct violation of the fundamental conservation laws of Vocabulary, Idioms and Phrases.

options.text: Its magnitude depends directly on the governing physical or analytical constants of Core Concept.
options.mistakeAnalysis: This is a factually correct principle of NCERT and cannot be chosen as an incorrect statement.

Detailed Solution:
